description: Java source code for an Android activity that demonstrates rendering a 3D compass using OpenGL ES and device sensors.

classes.name: CompassActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that renders a 3D compass using OpenGL ES and device sensor data.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes sensor manager and OpenGL surface view, sets renderer.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Registers sensor listeners and resumes OpenGL rendering.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Unregisters sensor listeners and pauses OpenGL rendering.

methods.name: onDrawFrame
methods.description: Renders the 3D compass, applying rotation matrix from sensor data.

methods.name: onSurfaceChanged
methods.description: Adjusts viewport and projection matrix on surface size change.

methods.name: onSurfaceCreated
methods.description: Initializes OpenGL settings and loads 3D model buffers.

methods.name: onSensorChanged
methods.description: Updates sensor data, computes rotation matrix and orientation, logs orientation periodically.
